title: OpenCode Desktop MCP Setup
goal: Update the two runtime MCP skills and the MCP setup workflow so new end users can configure OpenCode Desktop, local Pros MCP servers, and HubSpot Remote MCP smoothly without secret leaks.

out: Creating per-user HubSpot OAuth apps or secrets
Writing end-user secrets into runtime artifacts or case folders
Replacing local stdio SSOT sync for existing Pros MCP wrappers

constraints: No secrets in case folders, runtime artifacts, logs, chat output, opencode.jsonc, servers.yaml, or generated fragments.
No global MCP/client config change without explicit consent.
HubSpot Remote MCP must not be treated as a local stdio install.
OpenCode Desktop must be restarted after user environment changes.
Avoid opencode debug config for verification because it can print resolved secrets.

tasks.title: Add Remote OAuth MCP classification to install-mcp-server-pros
acceptanceCriteria: HubSpot is documented as official remote MCP, not local install.
Catalog/source installation is skipped for remote OAuth MCP targets.
Required OAuth app inputs and redirect URL are documented.

tasks.title: Add OpenCode Remote MCP setup rules to mcp-config-sync-pros
acceptanceCriteria: Local stdio SSOT and OpenCode remote OAuth entries are clearly separated.
HubSpot remote block uses env placeholders and no literal secrets.
Verification avoids secret-printing commands.

tasks.title: Decide and optionally implement safe OpenCode HubSpot helper
acceptanceCriteria: Decision recorded whether a helper script is needed.
If implemented, helper never prints secrets and writes UTF-8 without BOM.
Helper can merge or validate the OpenCode HubSpot remote block safely.

tasks.title: Extend werkzeuge-mcp-einrichtung HubSpot/OpenCode flow
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow has a remote OAuth branch for HubSpot.
Workflow includes consent gates for env, config, OAuth, and auth-store changes.
Workflow exposes needs-oauth, needs-secret-env, needs-desktop-restart, needs-reauth, and remote-configured states.

tasks.title: Document OpenCode Desktop OAuth runtime details
acceptanceCriteria: windows-runtime.md documents Desktop restart, current log paths, stale Tauri logs, and sidecar API limitation.
Auth-store JSON/BOM/null-field constraints are documented.

tasks.title: Document secret rotation and reauth path
acceptanceCriteria: Docs explain shared OAuth app and per-user OAuth tokens.
Rotation path updates env and either reauths or updates clientInfo safely.
No step requires pasting secrets into chat or files.

tasks.title: Run fresh-case regression test
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh pros init case can follow the workflow.
OpenCode shows local MCPs and HubSpot connected OAuth or clear needs-* states.
Non-mutating HubSpot tool call succeeds after OAuth.

tasks.title: Verify release and packaging impact
acceptanceCriteria: pros init ships updated runtime artifacts.
pros tools ships updated global tool skills where applicable.
Release artifacts contain no secrets or source-only SSOT.

doneWhen: install-mcp-server-pros distinguishes local install MCPs and OpenCode remote OAuth MCPs.
mcp-config-sync-pros provides a safe HubSpot/OpenCode Remote MCP setup path.
werkzeuge-mcp-einrichtung routes HubSpot Remote MCP through explicit consent and OAuth states.
Verification steps are redaction-safe and include Desktop restart guidance.
Fresh-case regression validates OpenCode Desktop and HubSpot OAuth behavior.
Release and packaging impact verified through runtime-builder tests and release dry-run.
